diagnosis.text: DIAGNOSIS: The claimer is not currently blocked — all 3 rewards are on cooldown and the last cycle correctly exited with "nothing claimable"; the 'unknown' failure reason is a code-ordering bug in `claimer.py` where `_classify_failure` (line 567) is called after `emu kill` (line 549), so the AVD is always dead when diagnosis runs and the function always falls back to its generic exception handler, leaving `summary['reason']` as `None` for every failure.
